title: dns.resolve raises TimeoutError when refreshing the overview
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.0.3 on Windows Server 2022 against eu-
central-1.

## Steps

To reproduce:
- With the log window open, start refreshing the overview.
- Start two workers at the same time.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

## Expected

As on every earlier run, refreshing the overview should just
complete.

## Actual

It hangs for the full thirty seconds and only the guard
timer ends it. Two workers started together reproduce it;
one worker alone works.

## Frequency

Reproduces only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/ui/view.py:212 in refresh
lattice/report/live.py:63 in tiles
lattice/net/dns.py:176 in resolve
TimeoutError: resolve timed out after 30s (host=eu-central-1)
